0022600193.text: Orlando (2-6, 0-4 at home, on a three-game losing streak) is 12th in the East and 3 games back in the Southeast, while Golden State (6-3, 4-1 at home, on a six-game winning streak) is 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 8th in the West. Orlando is without Desmond Bane (illness), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Orlando losing 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
